approved_scope.description: Adopt event history and per-change sessions in this repository and union-merge the retention ledger and changelog
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: Repository migration onto existing behavior (REQ-history-006, REQ-history-007, DRIVE-3): no requirement text changes.
acceptance_criteria: This repository runs Chough with event history and one session per change: the legacy transition log and migration backup stay byte for byte, the checkpoint moves to .chough/sessions/ byte for byte, and AGENTS.md tells agents to start each pull request with chough session new. The retention ledger and CHANGELOG.md merge with Git union. A simulated pair of parallel pull requests conflicts in .chough/ and CHANGELOG.md on main and merges with none of those conflicts on this branch; fledge lanes run verify passes on Linux.

answers.constraints: Leif (0xLeif) chose Adopt + new criterion (2026-11-05): adopt sessions and event history on main first, union merges for the ledger and CHANGELOG.md, DRIVE-12 for the product fixes. Adoption must land on main before other branches diverge.
